balanced_local.description: Checkpoint subset to keep on local disk after exact HF archival is complete.

conservative_archive.description: Checkpoint superset worth exporting to HF for long-term recovery and curve reconstruction.

selection_basis: preserve checkpoints explicitly used in downstream eval or row-recompute scripts
preserve checkpoints that anchor major performance transitions in recorded sweeps
preserve final or exported checkpoints that already back local aliases or HF exports
